purpose: Explain the admitted min1/cap100 QfO tradeoff against its matched canonical min4/cap100 control without another tuning arm or inference run.
candidate_export_scope: Use only the independently admitted lossless derived view. Original failed exports remain untouched; no producer bug is claimed fixed.
questions: Does the net loss of 391936 native pairs conceal substantial additions as well as removals? Count full unordered gene/species pair multisets and root memberships, ignoring arbitrary family IDs and row order while retaining multiplicity.

Do small GO/EC mean increases accompany changes in eligible-pair populations rather than increased serialized scores on the same pairs? Compare exact integer-millionth scores and decompose mean differences using the original denominators.
gates: Authenticate the v26 admission/summary, selected native-product pins, normalization receipt and both producers. Require the same complete 984137-gene universe, native reconciliation counts, consistent species ownership and zero duplicates in the admitted views. Recheck GO/EC aggregate JSON pins in each producer metric_files inventory and their participant identity. Bind the newly pinned raw files by scoring namespace, unique metric-file location, independently admitted count/mean axes and complete membership of each raw scored pair in its own authenticated native pair-confidence table. Hash every diagnostic input and helper before and after evaluation. Preserve all v26 method records and scores unchanged.
historical_raw_pin_limit: Pre-evaluation provenance inspection found that both original producer inventories pin the GO/EC aggregate JSON but not the corresponding raw gzip files. The four raw gzip pins above are first recorded for this diagnostic; do not claim historical producer hash authentication for them. Require namespace, aggregate, pair-membership and shared-value crosschecks, and retain this provenance limitation explicitly rather than silently treating new pins as old evidence.
orientation: Native comparison uses baseline=control and candidate=variant. Functional overlap uses left=variant and right=control, so original_mean_difference is variant minus control. Never reverse these axes when interpreting results.
verification: Run existing unit suites for both helpers. Independently recount complete root membership and native-pair intersections with a separate representation/streaming strategy, and independently parse raw rounded scores and reproduce count/sum/overlap/decomposition fields without calling the comparison helpers. Reconcile raw mean rounding with the published eight-decimal endpoint; do not require bit equality to rounded aggregates.
resources: One-CPU native contrast with 16 GiB RAM and two-hour limit on shared bizon; GO/EC overlap is small and single-process. These are read-only diagnostics, not additional scientific inference. Leave running OrthoBench job 24363 and unrelated work untouched; diagnostic timing is not pipeline benchmark timing.
limits: Post hoc development diagnostics. Pair changes do not establish correctness or uniquely identify a causal stage. Shared-pair conditioning changes the endpoint and cannot replace official scores or provide uncertainty. FAS is unseeded and excluded from this pair-score decomposition; its exported relation axis is not its sampled/scored denominator. This does not establish a protected-union accuracy gain or justify changing its precommitted pilot gate.
